label: admit062
claim: Sciences admits the conditional shape/cost account; no buildable floating P2 or qualified cheapest route is established.
source_report_body:
MAINLINE-062 ADMITTED to the Sciences map as attributed QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION; REVIEW-A pending, nothing independently cleared. All 14 artifact pins match (sha256 and bytes).

Carried: a buildable, floating P2 at a defensible price is not established. 047 is not admissible as a physical hull tolerance. Closed-form SF 1.05 dimple limits with the cure debit are 0.793/1.628/2.486 mm at R10/20/30 (no FE); the 0.6/1.2/1.8 mm shop caps are proposals, not capability. Unquoted first-shell projections run $66.5-477.4M, $0.52-3.81B and $1.84-13.45B, excluding full qualification. With concept growth all six payloads are negative (ISA -611/-2,554/-6,704 kg).

Programme state, from the 061 and 062 tables: no P2 or P3 case floats under concept mass growth; some do at the TRL7 allowance.

For REVIEW-A's brief: Piece A spans two PROCESS-v2 versions, 061 under be858ac1 and 062 under 0ca073ec.

This also receipts the REVIEW-A mint creator copy.
numerical_scope: Synthesis of attributed reports; consult named check/review findings for numerical disposition
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
